items.html:
The fourth first-class cricketer from a family that includes former Test captain Floyd Reifer, Raymond Reifer has made his name for his all-round abilities. A left-arm seamer who can score useful runs down the order, Reifer's mid-20s averages with both bat and ball reflect his consistency in first-class cricket. He played a major role in Guyana's run to the 2016-17 four-day title, with 36 wickets at 21.58 and 445 runs at 37.08, which earned him a maiden call up to the West Indies Test side ahead of their 2017 tour of England.
ESPNcricinfo staff
